Chapter 1167 - 27 Hunxiao And Yulin (Please Subscribe)_2

Chapter 1167: Chapter 27 Hunxiao and Yulin (Please Subscribe)_2

For an Absolute Saint, a special entity like the Eye of Myriad Laws is at most something to be wary of, but fear? Far from it.

After all, the Eye of Myriad Laws cannot intervene directly, while an Absolute Saint has essentially reached the pinnacle of the Chaos Void.

The Absolute Saint dares not provoke the Eye of Myriad Laws, fearing to attract the attention of the life behind it, but the Eye of Myriad Laws cannot force any Absolute Saint to do anything.

"Then please."

Lin Yuan looked at the Eye of Myriad Laws and said with a slightly solemn tone.

"Ah, I can only try, there’s no guarantee that Jade Qilin or Hunxiao will listen to me."

The Eye of Myriad Laws said directly.

Over the long years, he has formed good relations with many Absolute Saints, but to have them oppose two Absolute Saints, especially those from more than thirty million Cosmic Eras ago?

It’s difficult.

And it’s already too late.

Great Saint Jade Qilin and Great Saint Hunxiao dared not cause trouble while Xuanhuang was alive, but that does not mean these two Absolute Saints are weak.

On the contrary, Great Saint Jade Qilin and Great Saint Hunxiao are considered powerful among Absolute Saints.

The ability to endure under the cosmic suppression of an almost Invincible Great Saint like Xuanhuang for so many Cosmic Eras is not something an ordinary Absolute Saint can accomplish.

...

Outside the Xuanhuang Universe.

Two figures appeared silently.

These two figures stood calmly, and the rules of space-time and the Great Dao all retreated, permeated by an entirely new rule of the Great Dao covering from themselves.

Each Chaos Venerable shivered in fear, trembling under the invisible aura.

"Xuanhuang Universe?"

"This is the universe created by Xuanhuang; it’s been so long since I felt this kind of aura..."

The figure on the left, wearing jade armor and with an ancient gaze, looked at the distant entrance of the Xuanhuang Universe, his voice traveling through time and space. At that moment, all beings who heard the voice had their minds and wills affected, twisted, as though they would completely submit to the voice’s owner.

"Erase this Xuanhuang Universe, and there won’t be much trace left of Xuanhuang in this Chaos Void. The fear in our hearts will dissipate significantly, and then we can attempt to break through to the thirteenth stage."

The other figure spoke up.

The first to speak among these two figures was Great Saint Jade Qilin.

And next was Great Saint Hunxiao.

"Breaking through to the thirteenth stage will face time loops, not only will it be tests we’ve never encountered before, but they will also target our psychological weaknesses."

Great Saint Jade Qilin said in a low voice.

For these two Absolute Saints, Xuanhuang has already become something akin to a Heart Demon.

For over thirty million Cosmic Eras, the reason the two Absolute Saints kept pushing for the downfall of the Profound Xuanhuang lineage included a hatred for Xuanhuang.

They also want to erase traces of Xuanhuang’s existence, thereby weakening their own psychological obsession and Heart Demon.

Only in this way can they increase their chances of surviving the time loop.

"Let’s go, and see what Xuanhuang left behind."

Great Saint Hunxiao glanced at Great Saint Jade Qilin and first stepped into the Xuanhuang Universe.

Great Saint Jade Qilin followed closely behind.

Rumble...

As soon as the two Absolute Saints entered the Xuanhuang Universe.

They were immediately suppressed by the rules of the Xuanhuang Universe, but in an instant, the suppression originating from the Universe’s Origin Source was diluted and neutralized.

"Xuanhuang, this is merely a universe you left behind. In over forty million Cosmic Eras, its internal space-time has begun to collapse, and can no longer affect us."

Great Saint Hunxiao’s gaze was calm.

If Xuanhuang were still alive, no matter how bold they were, they would not dare enter this Postnatal Universe.

But Xuanhuang has already fallen into a time loop, with this Postnatal Universe operating and suppressing on instinct, how could it possibly deal with them?

...

In the deepest part of the Xuanhuang Universe.

Lin Yuan’s figure appeared, and at the same time, avatars from across the universe quickly approached him.

"Senior."

Lin Yuan released the Tomb Spirit, "Can you still merge the tomb into the depths of space-time? Just like it manifested before I arrived?"

"Such means of merging with space-time must be personally executed by His Majesty."

The Tomb Spirit paused slightly and shook his head, "Since you have come and inherited everything from His Majesty, even the tomb is now yours, naturally it cannot be merged."

"What’s wrong, has some issue occurred?"

The Tomb Spirit also noticed that Lin Yuan’s tone seemed a bit off.

"The two enemies of Your Majesty, Great Saint Hunxiao and Great Saint Jade Qilin have arrived," Lin Yuan immediately said.

"Those two?" Tomb Spirit’s expression subtly changed.

As the ’spirit’ created by Xuanhuang, it inherited some memories and was aware of these two peerless Great Saints.

"Before His Majesty last attempted to ascend to the thirteenth tier, he had specifically sought them out, killed thirty-nine of their physical bodies, and only stopped once the causal linkage was confirmed to have disappeared. Unexpectedly, they managed to endure it," Tomb Spirit said.

"Does this universe have any other exits?" Lin Yuan immediately asked.

"I am just the Tomb Spirit, not the Spirit of the Universe..." Tomb Spirit replied helplessly.

Boom.

Suddenly.

Lin Yuan’s expression subtly changed.

He could feel two presences different from the Xuanhuang Universe rapidly occupying the surrounding time and space, and in an instant, covering more than half.

Whether it was Lin Yuan or other Great Saints, upon entering the Xuanhuang Universe, they usually integrated their presence into the universe. However, these two presences were making themselves transcend the universe, even beginning to replace the laws and operations of the Xuanhuang Universe.

Swish.

Lin Yuan immediately stowed away the Tomb Spirit and simultaneously began communicating with the Eye of Myriad Laws.

In no time.

Great Saint Jade Qilin and Great Saint Hunxiao descended into the deepest part of the universe.

"Did not expect it’s Xuanhuang remnants." Great Saint Jade Qilin glanced at Lin Yuan and instantly recognized the aura indicating Lin Yuan practiced the evolutionary path of Xuanhuang.

From the time they entered the Xuanhuang Universe until now, the two peerless Great Saints had only spent ten breaths, unaffected in the slightest by the time-space suppression within the Xuanhuang Universe.

"Two Great Saints."

Lin Yuan spoke, with the exterior universe operating, resisting the oppression of the two peerless Great Saints.

"Interesting."

Great Saint Hunxiao gazed down at Lin Yuan, a smile appearing on his face, "Throughout so many Cosmic Eras, we have eradicated many Xuanhuang remnants. You are the most powerful of them."

Buzz!

At this moment.

Virtual air breath drew into shape, forming a giant eye.

"Hunxiao, Jade Qilin."

The Eye of Myriad Laws looked at the two peerless Great Saints.

He was reluctant to enter the Xuanhuang Universe, but it wasn’t impossible for him to do so.

"Eye of Myriad Laws?"

"What are you doing coming in?"

Great Saint Hunxiao appeared surprised. Perhaps other entities were unaware of their feud with Xuanhuang’s lineage, but the Eye of Myriad Laws certainly understood, so why bother joining at this moment?

"The Galaxy has causation with our Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion, may I let him out?"

The Eye of Myriad Laws spoke, "Rest assured, I can make him vow never to participate in anything related to Xuanhuang’s lineage in the future."

"Let him out?"

Great Saint Hunxiao looked at the Eye of No Laws, speaking blandly, "Eye of Myriad Laws, you really want to meddle in everything."

"Other matters can be discussed, but not this one."

Great Saint Jade Qilin directly said.

Although Lin Yuan wasn’t a peerless Great Saint, his strength was certainly at the pinnacle among Chaos Great Saints. Letting Lin Yuan go? It would absolutely be an unignorable hazard.

"We will not only refrain from letting him go, but we will also hunt all of his true bodies and avatars,"

Great Saint Hunxiao spoke.

It was precisely because Xuanhuang did not completely annihilate them that led to the insane revenge on Xuanhuang’s lineage by the two peerless Great Saints later.

Now, Great Saint Hunxiao naturally wouldn’t make the same mistake.

"Hunt all my true bodies and avatars?"

Lin Yuan’s expression subtly changed.

Originally, he intended to simply hand over his gains if there was truly no choice.

After all, given Lin Yuan’s growth speed, Great Saint Hunxiao and Great Saint Jade Qilin would at most just be temporary custodians.

Once Lin Yuan breakthroughs to the Chaos Realm and possesses strength akin to an Invincible Great Saint, he could easily retrieve it.

But to hunt down all his true bodies and avatars?

"Do you really have to take things this far?" The Eye of Myriad Laws hadn’t anticipated the two peerless Great Saints to be this ruthless.
